decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's existing sewer, utility and fabricated metal capabilities, so after only one year the option value of learning still outweighs the likely low cost of keeping it on offer.

Public waste bins are more distant from the core business and may require broader municipal sales effort, but they still use the firm's metalworking and coating strengths, so we would keep the line while market acceptance is still uncertain.
Ground sleeves for posts are a low-risk adjacent product line that fits standard fabrication, contractor demand and the firm's narrow portfolio, so we would keep this option open.

Cast iron ground sleeves fit the extension into ground sleeves but are somewhat less aligned with the firm's steel and stainless processing base, so they face a higher exit risk yet are still worth retaining for another year of market feedback.
Steel ground sleeves match the firm's core material and fabrication expertise well, making them an inexpensive and still-informative option to continue offering.
